_comment: Single source of truth for SSC model and configurator pricing. Used by the quote generator and other tools outside the website repo.
_source: CATALOGUE RESTRUCTURE (batch 4), ratified by Lee 2026-08-03 — pricesVersion 4. Four changes. (1) HEATER becomes a complete-sauna choice rather than an upgrade ladder: the base price now buys a finished sauna with a standard heater, electric OR wood-fired, at $0; the premium electric and premium wood (IKI) tiers price above it. (2) DELIVERY is no longer quoted anywhere — it is arranged at order, never a configurator line. (3) MOUNTING becomes an explicit select-one group: skid-mounted included, trailer integration +$3,500 with the trailer client-supplied. (4) costBasis: S6 and S8 come OFF hold on sauna-only stress costs; SC stays held on the photography gate alone. Prior basis: base-price reprice step 1 (2026-08-03, S2 -> 23500 and S4 -> 29500) at pricesVersion 3; js/data.js and src/_includes/modals/sauna.njk in ssc-website; derivations and margins in docs/redesign-2026-07/35-configurator-price-sheet.md and 30-pricing-heaters-equipment.md. Schema addition 2026-08-03 at pricesVersion 3: packages.premium_finish.upgradableGroups, encoding Lee's ruling that a package occupies the select-one groups its includes touch and a different choice in an occupied group bills at the delta, never at both prices and never below zero.
_schema: v2. The v1 file could not hold what the configurator now offers: one heater_apex entry cannot carry a per-model electric split, and there were no bench, deck-tier, window-tier, speaker-tier or per-model wood-fired structures at all. Options are now grouped exactly as the configurator groups them, and any price that varies by model is an explicit pricePerModel map rather than v1's 'model.interiorUpgrade' magic string, which every consumer had to know how to interpret.
_pricesVersionNote: Matches SSC.pricesVersion in js/data.js. Saved customer configurations are stamped with it; a mismatch means a stored total belongs to a superseded sheet. Bump both together, always.
_costBasisNote: Per-model build cost at the stress case, and the gross-margin floor the list price is expected to clear against it. `stressCost` values are the step-1 figures from the pricing-overhaul stress table. The website's scripts/models-json-roundtrip.mjs asserts (basePrice - stressCost) / basePrice >= gmFloor for every model. `held: true` marks a model whose list price is KNOWINGLY below its floor pending a later step: the assertion does not go red for it, but the gate prints a loud WARNING naming the model, its actual margin and `heldRef`. A permanently red tree teaches people to ignore red; silent passage would defeat the gate. Clearing a held model's price above its floor, or resolving its heldRef, is what retires the flag.

costBasis._stressCostRef: Sauna-only estimate at pricesVersion 4: the 27143 it replaces bundled a trailer the base price no longer assumes (mounting is now its own group). Skid materials extrapolated from the S2->S4 progression rather than taken off a build; a takeoff on the next S6 converts this estimate to a record.

Sauna-only estimate at pricesVersion 4: the 30082 it replaces bundled a trailer the base price no longer assumes (mounting is now its own group). Skid materials extrapolated from the S2->S4 progression rather than taken off a build; a takeoff on the next S8 converts this estimate to a record.

costBasis.heldRef: photography gate (Lee): the derived complete price from-$71,500 is parked until commercial photography ships. The trailer half of this hold retired at pricesVersion 4 (mounting is now its own group and the stress cost is sauna-only); the photography gate is the whole of what remains.

options.name: Standard wood-fired heater — Harvia M3 (included)
options._note: A null means the model has no standard wood-fired option: S2 on clearances (long-standing ruling, unchanged), SC because its commercial spec and size sit outside the M3. Availability on S4/S6/S8 is SSC FIELD EXPERIENCE, not the manufacturer's catalogue volume rating — built and tested including the S8, and manufacturer volume ratings run conservative (per Lee, 2026-08-03).

options.name: Homecraft Revive 9kW (Electric)
options._note: One slot previously sold the SC's 15kW Apex and the S2-S8 Revive at a single $2,000 that had only ever been costed for one of them.

options.name: Original-IKI (Wood-fired)
options._note: The premium wood tier, replacing the Kuuma Banya that was cut at a ~$3,000/sale loss. Priced OVER the standard heater this model actually includes: over the Harvia M3 on S4/S6/S8, over the standard electric stack on SC (which has no standard wood). That is why SC's step is the largest despite the same stove as S6/S8.

heater._note: THE COMPLETE-SAUNA PRINCIPLE (per Lee, 2026-08-03): the base price buys a finished, usable sauna. A standard heater — electric, or wood-fired where offered — is included at $0, and no configurator choice in this group is ever mandatory to make the build work. The two standard options are a CHOICE between included builds, not a discount and an upcharge. MARGIN CONVENTION: stove-category hardware runs at ~30% GM (per Lee, 2026-08-03), NOT the 45%/40% convention that governs the rest of doc 35 — the premium heater prices here are correct at 30% and must not be 'corrected' upward to 45% by a future audit. PROVENANCE OF THE $0 WOOD CHOICE: the standard wood stack, chimney kit and its install included, has historically been carried inside base materials on wood-standard builds (per Lee, 2026-08-03), so the $0 price absorbs nothing new and the base costBasis figures already cover it.

3' semi-enclosed deck — two finished side walls, covered roof

deck._note: Two tiers. One 'front deck' label was selling both builds, and the semi-enclosed build was below cost at the platform price.

mounting.label: Mounting

options.name: Trailer integration — trailer client-supplied
options.note: Covers integrating the build onto a road-legal chassis. The trailer itself is client-supplied; where SSC sources one instead, it is quoted separately by FINAL BOX LENGTH (model + changing room + deck, which stack) with GVWR re-checked at quote time.
options._provenance: Dealer chassis prices: doc 31 §1.6. Split out of `note` because `note` is CLIENT-FACING -- generate-document.js carries it verbatim onto the quote/estimate PDF as the line description, so an internal document citation was being printed for the customer. The underscore prefix is the file's existing rule for internal commentary that never leaves it (see the picker comment in generate-document.js): no renderer reads this field.

mounting._note: New at pricesVersion 4. Mounting was never a configurator choice, so a trailer build's chassis cost lived nowhere and the base price silently carried whatever the build happened to need. Skid is the included default; the trailer line prices the INTEGRATION work only, at $3,500 on every model, because the labour to marry a box to a chassis does not scale with box length — the chassis cost does, and that is why it is quoted separately rather than folded in. Sizing rule and the chassis price steps: doc 35 §2.7.

interior.label: Interior Wood
interior._note: Clear cedar is priced at thermowood parity on an assumption doc 35 §7.7 flags as unverified. The two are separate options precisely so they can diverge.

bench.label: Bench Configuration
bench._note: Both are included at no cost, but the choice is a build instruction and must reach the quote. It did not for the site's entire history.

options.note: Mounted outside the peak-heat zone; placement confirmed at consultation.

premium_finish.name: Premium Finish Package
premium_finish.description: Clear cedar interior, standing seam or cedar exterior, WiFi controller, lighting package, Bluetooth speakers (standard set).

audio._note: The one exception to delta pricing, and it is the shape this package has always had: the package carries the standard set, and the premium tier is priced OUTSIDE the package at its own canonical price, added on top. See optionGroups.audio._note.

premium_finish._upgradableGroupsNote: GROUP-SLOT occupancy, machine-readable. A package does not merely bundle option IDS -- it OCCUPIES each `select: "one"` group its `includes` touch, with the listed option as that group's baseline. Choosing a different option in an occupied group is an UPGRADE, billed at max(0, optionPrice - baselinePrice) and rendered as an upgrade line; never both prices, and never a negative line (a cheaper substitution clamps to $0 and reads as a substitution at no charge -- there is no downgrade credit). `pricing: "additive"` marks a group that is billed at full price on top instead, the documented audio exception. Per Lee, 2026-08-03. The generator asserts that the key set here EQUALS the set of select-one groups reachable from `includes`, so a package that grows a component cannot silently un-occupy a slot. `select: "any"` includes (wifi_controller, lighting_package) are NOT slots: selecting them alongside the package is a double-bill and is refused.
premium_finish._note: savings = (sum of `includes` at their à la carte prices) minus the package price. Must hold on every model — the MINIMUM savings across models is the advertised figure ($1,000 at pricesVersion 5; S8/SC actually save $1,500). Verified in CI by scripts/package-claim.test.mjs in the website repo, which scrapes the advertised figure off the rendered page rather than trusting this number. pricesVersion 5: standing seam absorbed into the package at the old cedar-baseline prices (SSC absorbs the $500/$1,000 delta), doubling the savings claim.

delivery._note: NOT QUOTED. As of pricesVersion 4 delivery carries no price anywhere in this file and appears on no quoting surface — no catalogue entry, no configurator line, no generator prompt. Delivery is arranged at order and discussed at consultation. The priced entries removed here (delivery_local $500, delivery_extended $3/km) were schema-v1 carry-overs that had survived two repricings without ever being re-derived, and the extended line was a $0 catalogue price that only became real if someone remembered to enter a distance. If delivery is ever priced again it gets a derivation like every other line, not a revival of these numbers.

standard_inclusions: One exterior accent wall (entrance wall is always T&G, never metal)
Standard heater at no extra cost, electric or wood-fired where offered — the base price buys a complete, usable sauna
client_responsibility: Electrical service to unit (licensed electrician required)

quoting_practice._note: Every quote carries a 30-day validity line. Quotes already issued before pricesVersion 2 are honoured for their stated validity, or 30 days from issue where unstated. Prices are firm; no discounting (per Lee, 2026-07-30).
